notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf008:l001: The final word is a letter-shape reading; it may instead be жоолугуп or another жоо- form. Completion-first direct manuscript transcription; uncertain forms and provisional English are queued for later review.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf008:l002: The first word is compressed and may be a different жүр- form; журтка тең болуп is clear.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf008:l003: The first and final words are plausible contextual readings of difficult cursive.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf008:l004: The middle word resembles коңшусун but is not secure on letter shape alone.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf008:l005: The line is visible, but the first verb and the phrase's intended sense remain provisional.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf008:l006: Кыргызу is preserved as written; the final two words are faint and could contain a different auxiliary construction.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf008:l007: The first word is likely Канчалык, but its ending is tightly compressed.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf008:l008: Калыска is the closest visible reading, though калыс деп may be intended; English follows the apparent sense.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf008:l009: All word groups are visible, but даарын бак is not lexically secure and the translation is provisional.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf008:l010: Кулан appears to be a proper name; the first word could instead be a closely related form such as ортоңку.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf008:l021: The first word resembles Суран but is not securely intelligible; иче тойбогон is clearer.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf008:l024: Кармаша is preserved as the visible form; it may be an adverbial or a differently inflected verb.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf008:l025: The final verb appears to be сомдогон, though the contextual formula may use a similar-looking verb.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf008:l027: The phrase is a close letter-shape reading, but its morphology and exact idiomatic sense are uncertain.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf008:l028: The first word is clear in sense but several letters are compressed; союлуп is the likeliest final reading.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf008:l029: The middle and final phrase is faint; орносун таалай деп is a contextual reading.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf008:l030: The line clearly includes Журт and Кененим; the syntax and final verb are read provisionally.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf008:l031: The final word appears to be коюлуп; арка may carry the idiomatic sense of protector or support.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf008:l032: The final baseline is fully visible, but арга конушуп is not lexically secure; English is provisional.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf009:l003: Ката is the closest letter-shape reading; the phrase may contain another lexeme.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf009:l004: The first word appears to be Алыс, but its inner letters are pale; the translation is provisional.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf009:l005: Сан кара is visually plausible and interpreted idiomatically as the mass of common people.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf009:l007: The final word is compressed and may instead be жыйналат or a related form.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf009:l008: оттор and таанылып are best-effort readings of faint cursive; English follows those readings.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf009:l010: The third and fourth words are difficult; талаа күлүш is a tentative letter-shape reading and the English is provisional.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf009:l015: The middle word is read as бурушкан from context and letter shape; its ending is not fully secure.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf009:l016: The final word resembles эрени; it may carry a different case ending.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf009:l017: Жаадай and балаң are tentative readings of densely joined letters; the English is provisional.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf009:l018: The line appears to read жайдары көп жан берени, but жан and берени remain lexically uncertain.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf009:l020: The grammatical ending in тилекке is normalized from a compressed form; белен is visually clear.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf009:l021: Баатырбыз is the closest visual reading, although the inflection is contextually awkward and may differ.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf009:l022: The first word appears to be Таалайды, but several medial letters overlap.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf009:l025: Каттоосундай is a letter-shape transcription of an unresolved first word; the English gives only a contextual approximation.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf009:l026: The middle word could be даяр or даар; даяр is adopted as the likely formula.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf009:l028: Эр бүл is unresolved and may be a single word or proper name; the remainder reads жүрсө жел тийбей.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf009:l029: өзөнгө is visually plausible; the idiomatic force of доо бербей is translated provisionally.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf009:l030: төбөй is the closest visual reading and may be a related verb meaning to rise or tower.
notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf009:l032: The final two words look like күр шумкар; this metaphorical description may conceal a horse name or different formula.
